E1.evidence: Maintainer-filed issue (AndyZe) confirming the defect: "As reported in issue #1506, the default `moveit_controllers.yaml` created by MSA is missing a few lines" (https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/1514). The linked #1506 has a reproducer (one-joint URDF, MSA-generated config, demo launch) and a full console log (https://gist.github.com/Cryoschrome/2e6a47a87e8ff89509822db4a7fb2585).

E2.evidence: Unit 1: moveit_setup_controllers (the MoveIt Setup Assistant package whose MoveItControllersConfig::GeneratedControllersConfig::writeYaml writes moveit_controllers.yaml). Unit 2: moveit_simple_controller_manager (the MoveItControllerManager plugin loaded by move_group, which reads moveit_simple_controller_manager.<controller>.* parameters). They are separate packages. The consumer requires the parameter (moveit_plugins/moveit_simple_controller_manager/src/moveit_simple_controller_manager.cpp at 7dd0434, lines 116-121): "const std::string& action_ns_param = makeParameterName(PARAM_BASE_NAME, controller_name, \"action_ns\");" / "if (!node_->get_parameter(action_ns_param, action_ns))" / "continue;"; and reads default with a fallback (line 197): "node_->get_parameter_or(makeParameterName(PARAM_BASE_NAME, controller_name, \"default\"), state.default_, false);". The value missing crosses the boundary (step 2 not met). The resolving change is in the provider's code (the generator now emits action_ns and default), not a deployment-time remap, so step 3 is not met; the parameter is part of the consumer's referenced interface. Not build (4) or firmware (5).

E3.evidence: PAIR: the file generated by the setup assistant is loaded into move_group and read by moveit_simple_controller_manager. #1506: "I have generated the configuration and launch files using `moveit_setup_assistant`. Launching `demo.py`, I am able to plan the trajectory but get the following error while executing the trajectory."

E4.evidence: Observed failure in the #1506 log: controller skipped at plugin initialization, then "Unable to identify any set of controllers that can actuate the specified joints: [ base_to_rotate_joint ]" and "MoveGroupInterface::execute() failed or timeout reached".

units.name: moveit_setup_controllers
units.revision_basis: Broken: the #1506 reporter states "Source Build" on the "Humble branch; commit: 7dd0434" (linked to 7dd0434f742d6586f32843802135ebcc2720c79c, 2022-08-10); that revision contains 8ee767a (2022-06-30, '[MSA] Add additional parameters to Controller definitions (#1408)'), after which writeYaml writes action_ns/default only from controller.parameters_, and Controllers::addDefaultControllers adds controllers without parameters. Issue #1514 itself names no revision. Resolved: PR #1515 merged to main 2022-08-17 as 066e8621166858d3f556726197b07643a1b685f9; the same change was backported to the humble branch as 2042b82c83da57dec35325efa21f6463c2b6a470 ('MSA: write the default controller namespace (#1515) (#1651)', 2022-10-28), which is used here to stay on the reporter's branch.

units.name: moveit_simple_controller_manager
units.revision_basis: The #1506 reporter built MoveIt 2 from source at humble commit 7dd0434; the consumer is not changed by the resolution, so it keeps that revision. (A second user in #1506 reports 'Humble and Moveit binary install on ubuntu 22.04' with the setup assistant built from main; no exact revision is given for that setup.)

failed_conditions.quote: [move_group-3] [ERROR] [1660542422.258335743] [moveit.plugins.moveit_simple_controller_manager]: No action namespace specified for controller `rotate_joint_controller` through parameter `moveit_simple_controller_manager.rotate_joint_controller.action_ns`

As reported in issue #1506, the default `moveit_controllers.yaml` created by MSA is missing a few lines:

```
    action_ns: follow_joint_trajectory
    default: true
```

loudness_evidence: At move_group start-up the consumer plugin refuses the controller with an error naming the missing parameter: "No action namespace specified for controller `rotate_joint_controller` through parameter `moveit_simple_controller_manager.rotate_joint_controller.action_ns`", followed by "Returned 0 controllers in list" (https://gist.github.com/Cryoschrome/2e6a47a87e8ff89509822db4a7fb2585). Judgement: this is the consumer's own parameter check at plugin initialization (a refusal enforced at activation), counted as loud_documented; the user-visible failure came later at execution: "Unable to identify any set of controllers that can actuate the specified joints: [ base_to_rotate_joint ]".

resolution.summary: The generator writes action_ns and default for FollowJointTrajectory controllers: in writeYaml, after the type key, "if (controller.type_ == \"FollowJointTrajectory\") { emitter << YAML::Key << \"action_ns\" << YAML::Value << \"follow_joint_trajectory\"; emitter << YAML::Key << \"default\" << YAML::Value << \"true\"; }" (PR #1515; humble backport 2042b82c).
resolution.evidence: PR #1515 was approved and merged (066e8621 on main; 2042b82c on humble), but no source shows a setup-assistant build at a fixed revision producing a working composition. The workaround equivalent to the fix was reported working with a hand-edited file rather than the fixed generator: "We had the same problem. We edited the moveit_controllers.yaml file with the text editor and added the two lines at the bottom." (AltinayGrass, #1506, Humble binary install).

notes: Regression origin: 8ee767a ('[MSA] Add additional parameters to Controller definitions (#1408)') replaced the unconditional action_ns/default emission with emission from controller.parameters_. The PR author confirms the fix restores that state: "I simplified this to be identical to the state before https://github.com/ros-planning/moveit2/commit/8ee767a49912476497a45917057654a3351dc465"; reviewer mikeferguson: "It seems like there must have been a recent regression". The composition is framed as PAIR (generated config feeds the consumer); both units come from the same humble revision in the reproduction, so the failure is not a version skew between them. Other compositions in #1506, not specified here: ros2_control's controller_manager rejected controllers because no ros2_controllers.yaml was loaded ("The 'type' param was not defined for 'joint_state_broadcaster'" and the spawner processes died); the maintainer's first reply addressed that ("You also need a `ros2_controllers.yaml`"), and the reporter's second log still shows the action_ns error. The top-level parameter moveit_controller_manager written by the same file is consumed by move_group's trajectory execution manager (a third unit), so it is not in the inventory. Follow-up defect: the unconditional emission added by #1515 later duplicated keys when parameters_ also held action_ns/default; fixed by 'Fix key duplication in moveit_setup_assistant for FollowJointTrajectory (#2959) (#3316)' (77b646ed on humble, 2025-02-05). A 2024 commenter reports that adding the two lines did not work for him and that a different, flattened file layout did; that concerns a different setup and is not used here. The controller name rotate_joint_controller comes from the #1506 reproduction; #1514 and PR #1515 use a generic example (arm_controller).
